honesty_note: The point construction was inspected during development. It is confirmatory against the pre-existing Stage 4 thresholds, but it is not a newly blind test.

gas_mass.estimator: OLS line through per-bin median log10(FGAS500)

gas_profile.source: Elkholy et al. 2015 Chandra density profiles, J/ApJ/805/3
gas_profile.fiducial: median potential factor across all valid published profiles at each BCG r/R500
gas_profile.uncertainty: one independent published profile draw per host and Monte Carlo realization

bcg_stars.shape: Prugniel-Simien deprojection of each NSA Sersic n and Re
bcg_stars.normalization: observed enclosed gbar*r^2/G; exterior shells add no fitted normalization

satellite_stars.profile_source: Wang et al. 2018 redMaPPer satellite scale radius

decision.continue_failure: retire algebraic H7s host-potential closure and derive environmental generalized Aether
decision.science_success: retain measured baryonic potential as the environment variable, but repair Stage 3 action identifiability before relativistic completion
forbidden: fit a host normalization to BCG residuals
